newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan investigates firms' use of fake invoices.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan investigates firms' use of fake invoices.

text.p: Taiwan prosecutors have begun investigating a group suspected of counterfeiting invoices alleged to have been used by 40 firms to carry out financial fraud, the Securities and Exchange Commission said on Tuesday.

"Prosecutors and police tell us they are investigating a group involved in making fake invoices worth over T$10 billion to be used by some 40 companies to obtain bank loans or help their listings," a commission spokeswoman told Reuters.

Few details were available about the group suspected of masterminding the scheme, which prosecutors said was run under an unlisted shell company, the spokeswoman said. She said those involved had denied any wrongdoing.
